english.title: Use / cause / permit a vehicle with a dangerous fuel and exhaust system to be used on part of Gatwick Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on part of Gatwick Airport - London to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..),

(A)_[used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[caused a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_
(C)_[permitted a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_

when the condition of the

(D)_[fuel]_
(E)_[exhaust]_

system was not such that no danger or nuisance was caused or likely to be caused to a person or property
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 5(7) and 2(2) of the Gatwick Airport - London Byelaws 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
